shots.camera: Extreme close-up, locked off, then a 6-frame snap zoom out
shots.action: A blue lightning arrowhead and a gold sun-fire arrowhead meet point to point in the center of a black frame and burst.
shots.sound: Silence, then one hard crack. No music.
shots.frame: Black frame. From the left, the tip of a steel arrowhead wrapped in blue lightning; from the right, the tip of a gold arrowhead wrapped in orange sun-fire. The two points almost touch at the exact center.
motion: 0-2s: both arrowheads tremble a hair apart, sparks drift.
2-3s: they touch; a 2-frame white impact frame.
3-4s: snap zoom out, the burst becomes blue and orange rings.

shots.camera: Extreme wide, 24mm, eye level, slow push-in
shots.action: Two chariots face each other across a cleared ring of red earth while two halted armies watch.
shots.sound: Wind, a far drum heartbeat, banners snapping.
shots.frame: Extreme wide of Kurukshetra at late afternoon. A cleared ring of trampled warm earth. LEFT: a gold chariot with four white horses and a canopy and a green ape banner. RIGHT: a gold chariot with four dun horses and a gold sun-bright elephant-rope banner. Halted armies as flat silhouettes on both edges. A huge low sun behind the right chariot. Figures are 5 percent of frame height.
motion: 0-5s: slow push-in toward the gap between the chariots, dust drifts left to right, banners ripple.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, 85mm, slight low angle, slow push-in
shots.action: Karna touches his bow to his forehead, then his eyes lift to screen left.
shots.sound: A low drone enters. A single bell.
shots.frame: @karna on his chariot, facing screen left, bow Vijaya held upright before his face, the low sun directly behind his head like a halo, grey-bearded Shalya soft in the foreground at the reins.
motion: 0-2s: he touches the bow to his forehead, eyes closed.
2-4s: eyes open and lift to screen left, slow push-in.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, 85mm, mirror of A03, slow push-in
shots.action: Arjuna draws Gandiva and blue static crawls up the bow.
shots.sound: Bowstring creak, electric crackle.
shots.frame: @arjuna on his chariot facing screen right, Gandiva held vertical at his side, @krishna soft in the foreground from behind with reins in hand, orange sky.
motion: 0-3s: he raises and draws Gandiva to the cheek, blue static crawls from grip to tips.
3-4s: hold, his eyes narrow.

shots.camera: Low tracking shot at wheel height, 18mm, fast dolly
shots.action: Krishna flicks the reins and the white horses surge forward.
shots.sound: Reins crack, hooves, drums kick in at 120 BPM.
shots.frame: Ground-level view beside the gold chariot wheel, four white horses' legs in front, red dust, @krishna's hands and yellow cloth visible above.
motion: 0-1s: the reins snap.
1-3s: the horses surge, camera tracks with the wheel, dust kicks toward lens.

shots.camera: Arrow-cam: camera launches with the arrows, 35mm, then whip-pan
shots.action: Karna looses a fan of seven arrows in one draw.
shots.sound: Seven whistles layered, a whoosh past camera.
shots.frame: @karna at full draw facing screen left, seven arrows nocked as a fan, sun-fire along each shaft, the sun behind him.
motion: 0-1s: hold at full draw, anticipation.
1-2s: release; the camera rides beside one orange arrow toward screen left.
2-5s: the fan spreads across the sky, a whip-pan left.

shots.camera: Medium wide, 35mm, camera shake on each hit
shots.action: Arjuna's arrows split Karna's arrows in mid-air, one by one.
shots.sound: Seven sharp metal clicks on the beat.
shots.frame: @arjuna firing at speed toward screen right, three blue arrows already in the air, the incoming orange arrows visible at the right edge.
motion: 0-4s: each blue arrow meets an orange one, each collision is a 2D spark star; one 2-frame impact frame (black, white, blue) on the last hit.

shots.camera: Crane up from ground to high top-down, 24mm
shots.action: The sky fills with so many arrows that they blot out the sun.
shots.sound: A rising roar of wind and shafts, then sudden quiet.
shots.frame: High angle over the duel ring, both chariots small, the sky above them half covered by a dense dome of crossing blue and orange arrows, armies below raising shields.
motion: 0-5s: crane up; the arrow dome thickens until the sun is gone and the frame drops into blue dusk.

shots.camera: Split-screen two-shot, both 85mm close-ups, locked off
shots.action: In the arrow-darkness the two warriors, exhausted, look at each other.
shots.sound: Heavy breathing, one heartbeat, music drops out.
shots.frame: A vertical split frame: LEFT half @arjuna close-up facing right lit only by blue light; RIGHT half @karna close-up facing left lit only by orange light. Both sweating, dust on faces.
motion: 0-4s: almost still; a slow blink from each, sweat runs, embers drift between them.

shots.camera: Macro insert, 100mm, rack focus
shots.action: Karna draws a single arrow from a golden quiver; its head is a serpent's mouth and its eye opens.
shots.sound: A dry hiss under the drone.
shots.frame: Macro of a golden quiver packed with sandal dust, one arrow standing apart with a dark serpent-shaped head, @karna's fingers closing on its shaft.
motion: 0-2s: the fingers pull the arrow up, rack focus to the head.
2-4s: the serpent eye opens, green-gold.

shots.camera: Low angle, 24mm, 90-degree orbit
shots.action: Karna draws the snake arrow to his ear and meteors fall from a red sky.
shots.sound: Thunder, a choir swell, Shalya's muffled voice (no words).
shots.frame: Low angle on @karna drawing the serpent-headed arrow to his ear, sky turned blood red, streaks of falling meteors, Shalya's shape behind him shaking his head.
motion: 0-4s: orbit 90 degrees around him as he reaches full draw; meteors streak down.

shots.camera: Wide, 24mm, whip-pan following the arrow
shots.action: The snake arrow tears across the sky, splitting it with a line of fire.
shots.sound: A shriek like a hawk and a snake together.
shots.frame: Wide sky over the battlefield, a single blazing line of fire cutting it in two from right to left like a parting in hair, the arrow at its head.
motion: 0-4s: the line races right to left; whip-pan to follow; the sky darkens either side of the line.

shots.camera: Low angle on the chariot floor, 18mm, then a hard drop
shots.action: Krishna presses his foot down and the chariot sinks a cubit into the earth; the horses kneel.
shots.sound: A deep earth boom; the drums stop.
shots.frame: Low angle at the gold chariot's floor, @krishna's bare foot about to press down, white horses ahead, white-gold light at his heel. Cut in on a 2-frame inverted negative flash.
motion: 0-2 frames: negative-flash cut (trailer rule: inverted flash as a cut), then back to color.
0-1s: the foot presses down.
1-2s: white-gold rings burst outward along the ground, a 2-frame white-gold impact frame.
2-4s: the chariot drops, the white horses bend their knees and kneel.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, 50mm, speed ramp 100 to 10 to 100 percent
shots.action: The snake arrow strikes Arjuna's crown off instead of his head.
shots.sound: Metal ring, slowed to a long tone.
shots.frame: @arjuna crouched low on the sunken chariot, looking up at screen right, the tall gold crown on his head, a streak of fire coming in at the top right.
motion: 0-1s: the fire streak hits the crown.
1-3s: slow motion: the crown spins away, his hair falls free.
3-4s: real speed, it lands in the dust.

shots.camera: Medium close-up, 85mm, slow push-in
shots.action: Arjuna rises and binds his hair with a white cloth.
shots.sound: Cloth snap. A single deep drum.
shots.frame: @arjuna_bare rising into frame from below, both hands tying a white cloth around his hair, eyes fixed on screen right.
motion: 0-2s: he pulls the knot tight.
2-3s: he lifts his eyes; blue static flickers on his shoulder.

shots.camera: Low wide, 18mm, the horizon tilts
shots.action: Karna's left wheel sinks; he leaps down and heaves it, and the whole earth lifts a little.
shots.sound: Grinding earth, a strained roar.
shots.frame: Low wide: @karna standing on the ground beside his chariot, both arms gripping the sunken left wheel, the wheel half buried in cracked red earth, the sun behind him.
motion: 0-2s: he heaves, veins stand out.
2-5s: the ground around him lifts and the horizon tilts a few degrees, dust pours off the rim.

shots.camera: Over-the-shoulder from Arjuna to Karna, 50mm, one 12-frame insert
shots.action: Karna raises a palm to ask Arjuna to wait; Krishna's look answers with a memory of Abhimanyu.
shots.sound: Karna (optional VO): "Partha, wait." A child's distant battle cry under it.
shots.frame: Over @arjuna_bare's shoulder (left, soft) toward @karna (right), standing by the sunken wheel, one palm raised, the bow lowered.
motion: 0-2s: Karna's palm rises.
2-3s: a 12-frame red silhouette insert: a young boy raising a chariot wheel as a shield.
3-4s: back on Arjuna's shoulder; it tightens.

shots.camera: Wide, 35mm, slow tilt down
shots.action: Arjuna's razor arrow cuts Karna's gold banner and it falls across the sun.
shots.sound: A snap, then a huge gasp from the Kaurava army.
shots.frame: Wide: the tall gold elephant-rope banner on Karna's chariot against the sun, a blue streak entering from the left.
motion: 0-1s: the blue streak cuts the pole.
1-4s: the banner falls slowly, crossing the sun; tilt down with it.
Selective color: the rest of the frame drains to grey for 6 frames as the blue streak hits, only the gold banner keeps color (trailer rule: selective color on impact).

shots.camera: Wide to extreme close-up, one continuous push, 24mm to 135mm feel
shots.action: Arjuna draws the Anjalika and rings of lightning ripple out from Gandiva.
shots.sound: Everything goes silent except a rising tone.
shots.frame: @arjuna_bare on the sunken chariot drawing Gandiva with a huge crescent-headed arrow, the bow switched to his left hand, rings of blue lightning around the bow, the sky darkening.
motion: 0-3s: one continuous push from wide to the crescent arrowhead.
3-4s: hold on the arrowhead, it shines like a small sun.

shots.camera: Impact frames, then a locked wide silhouette
shots.action: The Anjalika flies; Karna's silhouette stands against the sun as the sun goes dark.
shots.sound: A single thunder crack, then nothing.
shots.frame: Graphic impact frame: three flat colors only, black, white and blue; a white silhouette of an archer at left, radial speed lines toward the right.
motion: 0-0.2s: three impact frames.
0.2-3s: cut to Karna as a black silhouette against the sun; the sun dims to a dark red disc (no wound shown).

shots.camera: Wide, 24mm, crane up
shots.action: A column of light rises from where Karna fell and enters the sun.
shots.sound: A low choir, wind.
shots.frame: Wide: the field at dusk, a still dark shape on the ground by a sunken chariot wheel, the dim red sun above, a thin gold light beginning to rise from the shape.
motion: 0-5s: crane up as the light climbs into the sun and the sun brightens again; Shalya's chariot without its banner turns away.

shots.camera: Medium wide, 50mm, locked off, hold the final pose
shots.action: Arjuna lowers Gandiva and does not celebrate; Krishna watches the light.
shots.sound: One conch, far away. Music out.
shots.frame: @arjuna_bare standing on the sunken chariot, Gandiva lowered, @krishna at the reins beside him looking up at screen right, golden light on both faces.
motion: 0-2s: Gandiva lowers.
2-4s: hold; the final pose stays to the last frame.
